description: The overall picture from EVERY matching view in one small response: totals, up/down counts (asset views), how many providers lean each way, the busiest providers, a week-by-week trend, and the most-discussed assets or macro categories. Start here for "what is the consensus / how has it changed" questions, then read individual views with search_asset_views or search_macro_views.

category.description: Macro views only: a macro category key from list_categories, e.g. "monetary_policy".

kind.description: Asset (directional) views or macro theme views.

provider_id.description: Limit to one research provider (id from list_providers).

since.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Default: 30 days ago. The free plan reaches back 30 days for summaries.

terms.description: Subject words to match (assets, tickers, countries, central banks, companies, themes). Whole-word, case-insensitive; any term may match. Include synonyms and tickers, e.g. ["gold", "xau", "bullion"]. Omit to get everything in range. Asset views: matched against the asset name. Macro views: against the theme name and description.

until.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Default: today.

name: summarize_views
title: Summarize views
